subject: Demo request — onboarding automation
messages:
From: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-robotics.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-12T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Quick demo request — onboarding automation

Hi Irene / Priyom,

I was looking at Redwood on your site and used the chat widget this morning — I’m leading onboarding automation at Acme Robotics and would love a quick walkthrough of how your hosted API + Dedicated options could help us reduce per-customer latency for our device telemetry ingestion.

We’re available later this week. Prefer a 30–45 minute demo that covers: endpoints, latency expectations, and anything special for device data retention/compliance.

A couple windows that work on my side (ET):
- Thu 10/14, 11:00–11:45am ET
- Fri 10/15, 9:00–9:45am ET

Attaching a one-pager about our onboarding flow for context.

Thanks,
Sam Patel
Director, Onboarding Automation
Acme Robotics
sam.patel@acme-robotics.com
Attachment: company-overview.pdf (PDF, 220KB)
From: irene.choi@redwood.com <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@acme-robotics.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2026-10-12T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo request — onboarding automation

Hi Sam — great to meet you, and thanks for the context.

Thanks for sharing your availability. I’m looping in Priyom from our SDR team to coordinate the calendar and make sure the right engineer joins (we’ll include someone from the serving runtime team).

Two quick questions before we lock a time:
- Are you on Eastern Time? I want to confirm timezone for the invite.
- Do you prefer Zoom or a quick Google Meet?

If ET works, we can hold Thu 10/14 at 11:00am ET. Priyom — can you tentatively send an invite and include a short agenda (30–40m)?

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

—

Hey Sam — thanks for confirming. I’ve penciled in Thu 10/14 11:00am–11:40am ET and created a Zoom link. Attaching a brief agenda and a pricing snapshot so you have something to glance at before the meeting.

Proposed agenda:
- 10 min: introductions + goals
- 15 min: walkthrough (Hosted API + Dedicated capacity options)
- 10 min: latency/cost tradeoffs and deployment models for device telemetry
- 5 min: next steps / evaluation plan

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/0000000000 (passcode sent in calendar invite)
Calendar invite: sent to Sam + Rajesh and included Irene.
Attachments: proposed-agenda.docx, redwood-pricing-v2.xlsx

If any other folks from your team want to join, reply-all and I’ll update the invite.

Thanks — Priyom
Priyom Das | SDR, Redwood Inference
